title: College Football
description:
North Texas at Indiana
The Mean Green play the Hoosiers at the Memorial Stadium in Bloomington for a Saturday Week 1 opener. Indiana looks to maintain top form after finishing No.1 in the final 2025 poll, while visiting North Texas aims to improve off a No.24 rank finish.
